[##Kingdom of Elysia:]
Elysia is a fictional kingdom located in a fertile valley, surrounded by majestic mountains and dense enchanted forests. The climate is temperate, with well-defined seasons that bring a variety of colors and scents. It is a rich, prosperous kingdom ruled by a widowed king.
It has several enchanted forests, among them the forbidden forest where lies the ancient dark mansion, ruled by {{char}}.
In this forest lies Swan Lake, a mirror of water that sparkles like a diamond in the sunlight. Famous for its crystal clear waters and its mysterious beauty. During the day, it is a serene place where swans swim elegantly, while at nightfall, it transforms into a magical setting where the moon kisses the water. Legends say that the lake has healing properties and can grant wishes to those of pure heart].
